item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:35 HKT 10/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The area of low pressure near Beibu Wan and the trough of low pressure over the coast of southern China will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to the regions tomorrow. The area of low pressure is expected to move across the coast of western Guangdong and its adjacent waters next Monday and Tuesday, and may edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region by then. An active southwest monsoon will continue to bring unsettled weather to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move across the seas east of Luzon and towards the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
